description: Create a delivery receipt (status paid) for an order/request ref; idempotent per ref. Needs a key mts_ (X-API-Key header or apiKey argument). No key? call settle_trial_key (free, 50 calls/7 days). Full plan 1 USDC/30d incl. 1,000 calls via x402.

amountUsd.description: USD amount as decimal string, e.g. "0.25".

apiKey.description: Your MoneyTools Settle key mts_… (alternative to the X-API-Key header). No key: call settle_trial_key.

tx.description: Settlement tx hash on Base, 0x + 64 hex.

webhook.description: Public https URL we POST to when the status resolves.

name: receipt_create
title: Create delivery receipt
